title: 통일ㆍ북한 연구비 지급 규정 / queue:ADDENDUM:26944:20160203:00003:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDA (Enforcement Decree of the Public Officials Human Resources Development Act) <Presidential Decree No. 26944, Feb. 3, 2016>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

Article 2 Omitted.

Article 3 (Amendments to Other Statutes)
(1) through (19) Omitted.

(20) The Regulations on Payment of Research Expenses for Unification and North Korean Studies are partially amended as follows:

In Article 2, "Public Officials Education and Training Act" is replaced with "Public Officials Human Resources Development Act".

(21) through (23) Omitted.

Article 4 Omitted.
